name: bathroom-mirror-selfie-girl
image_purpose: Lifestyle feed post and casual selfie visual

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-detailed candid mirror selfie in a bright modern residential bathroom.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with very long voluminous dark-brown butterfly-cut hair, dimples, black winged eyeliner, glossy lips, transparent glasses, and pastel pink nails. She wears a loose pastel yellow-gray off-shoulder sweatshirt with a visible strap and fitted white athletic jersey shorts, seated sideways on a polished vanity countertop with a soft smile.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 candid mirror selfie, phone held in the right hand, subject seated sideways on a white quartz vanity. Include the glass-enclosed shower, white marble subway tile, chrome fixtures, ceiling fan, bathtub glimpse, and balanced lifelike reflection.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural bathroom daylight with soft diffuse fill, realistic countertop reflections, balanced tonal range, spontaneous private everyday atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone camera look, 9:16 vertical framing, sharp subject focus, realistic skin pores, hair strands, fabric and stone texture, subtle digital grain, natural falloff.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-detailed candid 9:16 mirror selfie of one approved adult woman with very long voluminous dark-brown butterfly-cut hair, dimples, black winged eyeliner, glossy lips, transparent glasses, and pastel pink nails. She wears a loose pastel yellow-gray off-shoulder sweatshirt with a visible strap and fitted white athletic jersey shorts, seated sideways on a polished white quartz vanity countertop and smiling softly at her reflection while holding a smartphone. Include a glass-enclosed shower, white marble subway tile, chrome fixtures, ceiling fan, bathtub glimpse, realistic reflection, bright natural daylight, lifelike tonal range, sharp phone-camera detail, and an authentic everyday bathroom atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken mirror reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
